description: Implementation of the Road Section from Kurunegala to Galewela, the First Phase of Section 4 of the Central Expressway Project, under 12 Contract Packages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-06-30, granted approval for the construction of the road section from Kurunegala (Ch.78+000km) to Galewela (Ch.116+500km), as the first phase of the fourth Section from Kurunegala to Dambulla of the Central Expressway Project. Bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method to select contractors for the execution of this phase, under 12 contract packages. The proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the bids received for the same, was approved by the Cabinet:
